verdict.rationale: Gusto's own docs show API-driven W-2 employee creation through the People Batch API and employee federal and state tax configuration as part of onboarding. The agent-friendly CLI exposes employee and compensation commands, and the MCP server lets AI tools interact with the Embedded Payroll API. However, compensation setup is evidenced only as a CLI command name, and no documented end-to-end single-employee onboarding flow ties the three steps together. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for employee compensation, an explicit end-to-end new-hire onboarding sequence via the API, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing onboarding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup
